## Overview

This page can hold your selected papers, preprints, thesis chapters, posters, and conference contributions.

## Selected Publications

::: {.publication-list}

### Journal articles

- **Add a publication here**. Include authors, year, title, journal, and DOI or URL.
- **Add another publication here**. Keep the citation style consistent across entries.

### Preprints and manuscripts

- **Add a preprint or manuscript here**. You can link to the repository, arXiv, or journal page.

### Conference presentations and posters

- **Add a talk or poster here**. Include the event name, location, and date.

:::

## Recommended format

Use a short citation, a one-sentence summary of the contribution, and a link to the final version when available.

Example structure:

- **Author, A., Author, B. (2026).** _Title of the paper_. Journal Name. [DOI](https://example.com)
- **Author, A. (2025).** _Title of the preprint_. [arXiv](https://example.com)
